what: EMERGING AI LAW MAP and AI -> CURRENT LEGAL ANCHOR MAP.

gapClassMeaning.EXPLICIT_RULE: the text addresses it in its own words
gapClassMeaning.GENERAL_RULE: a general category the problem would arrive in
gapClassMeaning.ANALOGICAL_ENTRY_POINT: a route by analogy to an existing procedure
gapClassMeaning.PROCEDURAL_ONLY_ENTRY: a forum and a procedure, no substantive rule
gapClassMeaning.UNCLEAR: the texts held do not settle it
gapClassMeaning.NO_OBVIOUS_ANCHOR: no route found in the texts held

aMissingAIStatuteIsNotAGap: the question is not whether Saudi Arabia needs an AI law. It is how much of the emerging problem existing law can already absorb.

anchors.quote_ar: يجوز الاستعانة بالتقنيات الحديثة في إجراءات الإثبات، بما في ذلك الذكاء الاصطناعي، ويُستغنى عن أي إجراء تحققت غايته باستخدام هذه التقنيات.
anchors.what_it_anchors: AI as a TOOL OF THE EVIDENTIARY PROCESS
anchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: AI as a source of liability, as an author, or as a subject of a claim

anchors.quote_ar: يجوز الاستفادة من تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإجراءات الإلكترونية، ويستغنى عن أي إجراء تحققت غايته باستخدام تلك التقنية.
anchors.what_it_anchors: AI as a TOOL OF COMMERCIAL COURT PROCEDURE, in the instrument governing the forum this corpus observes

anchors.quote_ar: وللوكالة استخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي للقيام بخدمات التنفيذ.
anchors.what_it_anchors: AI in the delivery of enforcement services
anchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: liability for an AI-delivered enforcement act

anchors.quote_ar: يستفاد من التقنيات الحديثة والذكاء الاصطناعي في إجراءات التوثيق، ويستغنى عن أي إجراء تحققت غايته باستخدام تلك التقنيات.
anchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: the validity consequences of an AI-assisted notarial act

anchors.quote_ar: يشمل الدليل الرقمي الآتي: 1. السجل الرقمي. 2. المحرَّر الرقمي. 3. التوقيع الرقمي. 4. المراسلات الرقمية بما فيها البريد الرقمي. 5. وسائل الاتصال. 6. الوسائط الرقمية. 7. أي دليل رقمي آخر.
anchors.what_it_anchors: the category into which AI-generated or AI-manipulated material would arrive as EVIDENCE. Item 7 is open-ended on its own terms.
anchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: authenticity of synthetic material, which the text does not address in these words

anchors.quote_ar: يجوز اعتبار الدليل الإلكتروني حجة في الإثبات، على أن تتضمن اللائحة وسائل التحقق من الدليل الإلكتروني وإجراءات تقديمه.
anchors.what_it_anchors: admissibility of electronic evidence in the observed forum, with verification delegated to the regulation
anchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: a verification standard for synthetic media

anchors.instrument: الترتيبات التنظيمية للهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي
anchors.quote_ar: تكون الهيئة الجهة المختصة في المملكة بالبيانات (بما في ذلك البيانات الضخمة) والذكاء الاصطناعي، والمرجع الوطني في كل ما يتعلق بهما من تنظيم وتطوير وتعامل
anchors.what_it_anchors: the REGULATORY competence for AI, which is an authority and not a court

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: the digital-evidence chapter of the Evidence Law and article 55 of the Commercial Courts Law, whose verification means are delegated to the implementing regulation
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a judgment in which a party disputes the authenticity of digital material on grounds of synthetic generation
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: any court-voice citation of the digital-evidence articles co-occurring with a dispute over authenticity
issueFamilies.note: the category exists and is open-ended; what the quoted text does not contain in these words is a standard for synthetic material

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: the same evidentiary route, plus forgery procedure (دعوى التزوير) which the Evidence Law carries as its own chapter
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a forgery claim whose subject is machine-generated material
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: co-occurrence of forgery-procedure articles with digital-evidence articles in one judgment

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: the Civil Transactions Law's general contract formation rules, which this repository holds but which contain no AI-specific wording
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a dispute over consent or authority where one side's act was machine-generated
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: a CTL contract-formation article rising sharply alongside electronic-evidence articles

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: general civil liability and contractual good-faith rules
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a claim founded on a statement produced by a system rather than a person
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: no specific marker; caught by the surprise ledger

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: professional regulation plus general liability. The Law Practice Law is in this corpus at low volume.
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a claim against a regulated professional whose work product was machine-generated
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: law-practice articles co-occurring with a liability claim

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: regulatory supervision by SDAIA, and sector rules such as the credit-information regulation's treatment of a negative decision taken wholly or partly on recorded information
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: an administrative or regulatory challenge, which is the administrative judiciary's forum and NOT this corpus

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: labour and regulatory routes, neither of which is this corpus's docket
the Labour Law, recently amended, whose disputes go to labour courts
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a labour claim naming an automated process

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: the Copyright Law, which appears in this corpus at low volume
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: an authorship or infringement claim involving generated material
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: copyright articles rising in the commercial forum

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: the Personal Data Protection Law and its licensing and penalty machinery, which are regulatory rather than commercial
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a PDPL penalty decision, which this corpus does not carry
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: NOT_OBSERVABLE_HERE; tracked through CUR-2026-003 and CUR-2026-004
issueFamilies.note: explicit in its own domain, and that domain is not this forum

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: government tenders and procurement law; disputes go to the administrative judiciary
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a procurement challenge naming an AI system

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: administrative-law review, the Board of Grievances' forum

issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a claim over reliance on machine-generated advice

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: contractual liability under the Civil Transactions Law
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a service-failure claim where performance was autonomous
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: a CTL liability article rising with a technology counterparty

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: agency and vicarious-liability concepts in the Civil Transactions Law
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a claim allocating responsibility for an autonomous act
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: no specific marker; this is the family most likely to need new law
issueFamilies.note: the honest answer is that the quoted texts this repository holds do not address it in these words, and that is a statement about the texts held, not a finding that Saudi law is silent

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: the Companies Law's rules on organs, authority and resolutions
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a challenge to a corporate act taken by an automated process

issueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: the procedural instruments already permit AI use; the question is what follows when the permitted use goes wrong
issueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a judgment in which an AI-assisted procedural step is challenged
issueFamilies.WATCH_CONDITION: any court-voice citation of the four permission articles
issueFamilies.note: the strongest anchor family, and it anchors PERMISSION rather than CONSEQUENCE

firstCaseReadiness.what: FIRST-AI-CASE READINESS. The capture schema is defined BEFORE the first validated AI-material dispute appears, so the first one is recorded against a fixed template rather than described after the fact.
firstCaseReadiness.trigger: a judgment in this corpus in which an AI system is material to the dispute, not merely mentioned. Materiality is decided by the AI radar's existing L3 rule, which currently returns zero.
capture_fields: ai_issue_family (from the emerging AI law map)
new_doctrinal_source (identity not previously in the canon)
forbidden: inferring AI involvement from writing style
treating a mention of AI as an AI-material dispute
predicting the outcome of the case
naming a judge, a party or a firm
firstCaseReadiness.baseline_at_definition: zero AI-material disputes in the observed corpus. The schema is armed against a base rate of zero, which is the point.
